content: lucide-astro (community package, dzeiocom) is deprecated per its own README: 'Use @lucide/astro'. @lucide/astro is the official lucide-icons org package, current v1.30.0, tree-shakable Astro components, TypeScript typed. Confirmed already installed in this project (package.json + node_modules) at v1.29.0 despite CLAUDE.md/UI-SPEC referencing the deprecated lucide-astro package name.
